capabilities: Convert a marked Markdown file into one note per tree node
Link parent and child notes with Wikilinks
Insert node markers into legacy or compatible Markdown
Set the output location and overwrite policy for generated folders
disambiguation: Not a tree or mind-map viewer; it converts a marked export into plain linked notes, not a visual tree.
extras: Command labels are shown in Chinese; parser rules live in a separate FORMAT.md, not the README. Version 0.1.0 has not been verified on a physical mobile device, and the write phase is not transactional if an exception interrupts it.
intentEvidence: Tree Obs is an independent companion plugin for Tree Chat. It has its own repository and runs separately.
problem: Tree Chat exports are a single Markdown file, and Obsidian has no built-in way to split that file into one note per node with parent-child links.

relations.evidence: Tree Obs is an independent companion plugin for Tree Chat.

summary: Markdown converter that splits a marked Tree Chat tree export into one note per node, linked with parent-child Wikilinks for graph view.
